page.content:
Revenue-share program that turned uploads into a job.

How YouTube Partner Program connects

  • Item: Google AdSense — The Partner Program shares AdSense-style ad revenue with channels.
  • Topic: YouTuber — The Partner Program turned 'YouTuber' into a paying occupation.
  • Item: YouTube Play Button — Play Buttons mark subscriber milestones in the Partner era.

What is YouTube Partner Program?

The YouTube Partner Program (YPP), opened widely in the late 2000s, splits advertising revenue with qualifying channels and still defines who counts as a professional YouTuber.

Key threads lead to Google AdSense, YouTuber and YouTube Play Button.
